notes.title: Police Shootout Prologue v1.01 update
notes.content:
Hello!

We have the first small update of the prologue.
We are reading all your feedback; more things are coming!

- We fixed shotgun shooting animation issue happening when player start shoot just after taking out the gun
- Fixed situation when player could start conversation with NPCs in some wrong moments
- Fixed level selection issue on the map

Police Shootout Team :)

notes.title: Prologue - Released - PLAY FOR FREE
notes.content:
HELLO OFFICERS! 👮‍♀️👮‍♂️

🚨Police Shootout: Prologue is NOW on Steam! 🚨
You can download it totally for free! Just click the link below 👇 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1661280/Police_Shootout_Prologue/
🚔 PROLOGUE | SUGGESTIONS & FEEDBACK

👮‍♀️ PROLOGUE | BUGS & PROBLEMS

PLAY NOW 🔥

Some of you are surely wondering what a prologue is? 
So Police Shootout: Prologue is a part of the full version of the game and is completely free. You will get to know many new interesting features, especialy voice overs for 13 languages. The most important is that prologue allows you to get into the world of Police Shootout so you will be fully ready before the final product release! We count on your feedback and suggestions for the game. 😊

Join our community on Discord!

The full version is coming really soon, so stay tuned. 😊
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1279240/Police_Shootout/

Regards, 
Police Shootout Team

notes.title: Join the Police Shootout: Prologue Playtest!
notes.content:
Hello Officers! 👮‍♀️ 👮‍♂️ 

🚨 We just announced the possibility to sign up for the Playtest of Police Shootout: Prologue! If you missed this information, make sure to check the link below for all the necessary information. 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1279240/Police_Shootout/

🚔 Our first Playtets are coming soon, so don't miss your chance!
[previewyoutube=ZUAuWC9HSDc;full][/previewyoutube]

Please remember, for now, we are gathering people willing to participate in Playtests, so please be patient, as soon as we send out the first invitations, we will inform you about it. So if you want to be up to date with the latest news follow the three simple steps: 
✅ Add the game to your Steam wishlist
✅ Follow the game on Steam
✅ Join our Discord community

Therefore, don’t wait! Become a part of group testers and what is most important be part of our game! We are waiting for you! Sign up for Police Shootout: Prologue PLAYTEST right now! 💪
